data.name: Bonus Feats
data.description: A skulking slayer can select the Surprise Follow-Through feat in place of a rogue talent. At 10th level, she can select the Improved Surprise Follow-Through feat in place of an advanced rogue talent (if she already has Surprise Follow-Through).
